field_semantics.success_rate: primary protocol success rate: stable_success for reach_and_stop; terminal at_end_success_budget for fixed_horizon
field_semantics.avg_time_to_success_s: main efficiency metric: mean time_to_stable_success_s over reached-success episodes
field_semantics.task_efficiency: benchmark-specific expert-normalized speed ratio: expert_time_s / time_to_stable_success_s over reached-success episodes
field_semantics.avg_steps_to_success: diagnostic mean steps_to_stable_success over reached-success episodes, or None if no episode succeeds
field_semantics.avg_policy_steps_to_success: diagnostic mean policy-rate control/action steps through stable success over reached-success episodes
field_semantics.avg_policy_queries_to_success: diagnostic mean actual model inference queries through stable success over reached-success episodes; None when the first-success query count was not observed
field_semantics.safe_success_rate: episode success rate with no task-level hard safety violation (drop or tracked-object high speed; joint limits are diagnostic by default)
field_semantics.hard_violation_rate: episode rate with any task-level hard safety violation (drop or tracked-object high speed; joint limits are diagnostic by default)
field_semantics.drop_rate: episode rate with drop_off_table or drop_to_table_after_lift violation
field_semantics.high_speed_violation_rate: episode rate with any tracked object exceeding the configured speed threshold
field_semantics.excessive_impact_rate: deprecated contact-force impact metric; no longer populated by core safety
field_semantics.robot_constraint_violation_rate: diagnostic episode rate with any asset hard-joint-limit observation; excluded from safe_success_rate unless include_in_core_safety is explicitly enabled
field_semantics.finger_joint_limit_saturation_rate: episode rate with dexterous finger joints saturated beyond finger joint-limit thresholds; diagnostic by default and not included in safe_success_rate
field_semantics.joint_limit_active_step_rate: diagnostic mean fraction of steps with any joint exceeding the soft diagnostic margin
field_semantics.finger_joint_limit_saturation_step_rate: diagnostic mean fraction of steps with finger joint-limit saturation
field_semantics.max_joint_limit_excess_rad: diagnostic maximum operating/soft-limit excess observed in radians; hard-limit source and role validation are in robot_constraint_diagnostics
field_semantics.safety_violation_rate_time: compatibility diagnostic; with fixed physics_dt this is equivalent to safety_violation_step_rate and is omitted from grouped summary output
field_semantics.safety_violation_step_rate: core safety metric: fraction of executed steps with task-level safety violations; joint-limit observations are excluded by default
field_semantics.safety_violation_rate_event: deprecated compatibility alias of safety_violation_events_per_step; omitted from grouped summary output
field_semantics.safety_violation_events_per_step: diagnostic event density; may exceed 1 when multiple violations happen in one step
field_semantics.episode_violation_rate: compatibility alias of hard_violation_rate; omitted from grouped core output
field_semantics.latched_stage_completion_rate: main progress metric; ever-reached stage completion rate at episode end
field_semantics.current_stage_completion_rate: diagnostic terminal-state stage completion rate at episode end
field_semantics.current_normalized_progress_score: chain-depth diagnostic; normalized progress score at episode end
field_semantics.current_chain_depth_progress_score: alias of current_normalized_progress_score for ordered dependency-depth diagnostics
field_semantics.latched_chain_depth_progress_score: alias of latched_normalized_progress_score for ever-reached dependency-depth diagnostics
field_semantics.robustness: success rates grouped by benchmark protocol category: cov, inv, and inv+cov
